what: The audit's own probe, re-run against this branch as a baseline regression
how: Unchanged. It boots an isolated framework host with Nafinity's real autoloader and route file; the project's own database, queue and LDAP are never started.

controller_dispatch.body.handler.meaning: The dispatcher ignored a bound target class and built the one named in the route. It now prefers the binding, which is what makes a controller replaceable.

unchanged.home_after_application_routes: the application's own home route still wins over a plugin's early one, exactly as before
unchanged.note on permissions: The probe boots a bare framework host, so no extension pass has run and nothing is registered. Access falls back to the built-in permission names there, so ProjectPermissions stays the compatible access it has always been and this reading is the audit's. A contributed permission still needs its definition to count.

services_are_final.note: Still final on purpose. Replacement goes through the contracts, not through inheritance.
